page_title: Monosnap - Screenshot Tool with Cloud Storage

sources.entry: Monosnap - Make screenshots. Draw on it. Shoot video and share your files. It's fast, easy and free. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/monosnap/id540348655?platform=mac)

summary.name: Monosnap
summary.one_liner: Monosnap is a screenshot and screen recording tool for Mac and PC that can annotate captures, record video, and upload files to your own cloud storage.
use_cases: record screen video for bug reproduction
blur emails or API keys before sharing a screenshot
upload files and screenshots to your own cloud bucket
send visual bug reports to AI coding tools
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Monosnap capturing screenshots (including with an 8x magnifier), recording videos, and highlighting UI elements. Its local Blur Tool is said to mask emails, API keys and financial numbers before screenshots leave the machine. Captures can be stored in the user's own AWS S3 or DigitalOcean Spaces bucket. Several listed features (AI/OCR search, one-click secret blur, AI vision and MCP copy, studio frame beautifier) are marked as coming soon. The page is largely marketing for Monosnap's wider FractalOps AI products, and its performance and compliance figures are unverified claims.
notable: Local Blur Tool to mask sensitive data before upload
Bring-your-own cloud storage (AWS S3, DigitalOcean Spaces, R2, SFTP mentioned)
Screenshots, annotation and video recording in one tool
caveats: Several features (AI/OCR search, one-click secret blur, AI vision/MCP, studio frame) are marked SOON and not yet available
Performance and compliance figures on the page are unverified marketing claims
Page mixes Monosnap with separate FractalOps AI products, which may require their own accounts or fees
